test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
G, H, I, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 6, the floor above it is numbered 5, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 1.

J lives on an even numbered floor. G and K each live on an odd numbered floor. I lives on floor number 2. H lives on an odd numbered floor, immediately above L and immediately below I. G does not live on the topmost floor. Who lives on the lowermost floor?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• G, H, I, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 6, the floor above it is numbered 5, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 1.
 
• I lives on floor number 2. H lives on an odd numbered floor, immediately above L and immediately below I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53fcc70e7db126db8a513771e4c07c7f9fbd39e8794c4135ee076e65cf26323d.png] 

 
• J lives on an even numbered floor. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e71ea70ed819fa39eddeae02e976f6d54cf002b4b256856ddcd74cd4ab158ee.png] 

 
• G and K each live on an odd numbered floor.G does not live on the topmost floor. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a88d6f3bf5a07f433137dfd1095e1a52e1e5349c4598609a55e6c44d9e28345a.png] 

So, **J** lives on the lowermost floor.

Therefore, **the correct answer is option 4.**
